pages.text: Completed pills fall into four grades: low, middle, high, and perfect. Quality affects potency and trade value, as well as the breakthrough support provided by controlled pills such as the Foundation Establishment Pill.

pages.title: Quality Multipliers
pages.text: Low quality provides about 0.7x potency and 0.6x trade value. Middle quality is the 1.0x baseline. High quality provides about 1.25x potency and 1.5x value, while perfect quality provides about 1.5x potency and 2.5x value.

pages.title: Influencing Factors
pages.text: The quality roll depends on base success chance, herb age, furnace compatibility, alchemy skill, and realm-level flame control. Failure or a furnace explosion yields no pill. Controlled pills are valued mainly for their actual breakthrough bonus rather than an ordinary market price.

pages.title: Current Status
pages.text: Low-tier pills and part of the formula and alchemy data are already available. Quality support is expanding across more formulas; individual pill pages distinguish implemented behavior from planned content.
